title: Covered Is Not Checked: Which Branch Outcomes Would Your Tests Notice?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33708v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code coverage reports what tests execute, not whether tests detect faults. Checked coverage addresses this gap by tracing code that influences test oracles through dynamic slicing, but slicing is costly, and Java slicers struggle with modern language features and complex programs. We present Veritas, a slicing-free approach that directly tests whether covered behavior is checked. We target object branch coverage (OBC), a compiled-code structural criterion with fault-detection effectiveness comparable to source-level Modified Condition/Decision Coverage (MC/DC), which is required at the highest assurance level of DO-178C. For each covered object-branch outcome, Veritas forces the opposite outcome and credits checking only when the change is executed, a previously passing test fails, and the failure is attributable to that outcome. Thus, Veritas distinguishes execution from demonstrated fault detection without dynamic dependence analysis.

translated_title: 覆盖不等于检验：你的测试能注意到哪些分支结果？
translated_abstract: 代码覆盖率报告的是测试执行了什么，而非测试能否检测出缺陷。检验覆盖通过动态切片追踪影响测试判定基准的代码来弥补这一差距，但切片成本高昂，且Java切片器难以处理现代语言特性和复杂程序。我们提出了Veritas，一种无需切片的方法，可直接测试被覆盖的行为是否真正被检验。我们针对对象分支覆盖（OBC），这是一种基于编译代码的结构化准则，其缺陷检测效果可与源代码级的修正条件/判定覆盖（MC/DC）相媲美，后者是DO-178C最高保证等级所要求的标准。对于每个被覆盖的对象分支结果，Veritas强制其产生相反的结果，并且只有当该变化被执行、原本通过的测试失败、且该失败可归因于该结果时，才将其计入检验。因此，Veritas无需动态依赖分析即可区分代码执行与已证实的缺陷检测。
tldr: 提出无需切片的Veritas方法，通过强制相反的分支结果并验证原本通过的测试是否因此失败，来判断被覆盖的分支结果是否真正被测试检验，从而无需动态依赖分析即可区分代码执行与实际缺陷检测能力。
en_tdlr: Veritas, a slicing-free approach, determines whether covered object-branch outcomes are actually checked by forcing the opposite outcome and crediting checking only when a previously passing test fails due to that change, distinguishing execution from demonstrated fault detection without dynamic dependence analysis.
